Delightful!
Jan 2024 • Couples
I travel a lot and eat in many restaurants around the world. I can absolutely say that this restaurant has delicious dishes! Underground parking for scooters, two floors of restaurant, sale of typical products with own production. I think they absolutely deserve 5 and even more stars! Friendly and kind staff even if they don't speak English very well, the owners are very nice and also speak perfect English. Lots of variety of fresh dishes, hot soups and very quick preparation times. I was skeptical at first but having tasted most of the dishes on the menu, I can definitely and conscientiously support it! The cost is really great because you can also eat tasty food at a very low price. I also worked several days with my computer and they were happy to have me as a guest from lunch to dinner. I will definitely come back and choose it a thousand more times! Fantastic!

Amazing food and service
Mar 2023 • Couples
The food here was exceptional. We had the papaya salad, friend tofu with lemongrass and chilli and Bo Hue. We were pleasantly suprised at the generous portion sizes. Back home you may get 6-8 pieces of friend tofu when ordering. Here you get a whole plate of it! The service was impeccable and all the staff we interacted with were polite and friendly. We were so happy that we wanted to let them know. So when we approached the counter to compliment their restaurant, my husband and I were invited upstairs. We were then introduced to the owner/chef, who was so welcoming and warm. We will definitely be back and letting people know where to get a great vegan feed in Nha Trang.
